const countExpenses = `-- name: CountExpenses :one
SELECT count(*) FROM F_EXPENSE
WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = $1::bigint
  AND ($2::bigint IS NULL OR project_id = $2::bigint)
  AND ($3::text IS NULL OR status = $3::text)
  AND ($4::bigint IS NULL OR applicant_user_id = $4::bigint)
`

type CountExpensesParams struct {
	TenantID        int64   `json:"tenant_id"`
	ProjectID       *int64  `json:"project_id"`
	Status          *string `json:"status"`
	ApplicantUserID *int64  `json:"applicant_user_id"`
}

func (q *Queries) CountExpenses(ctx context.Context, arg CountExpensesParams) (int64, error) {
	row := q.db.QueryRow(ctx, countExpenses,
		arg.TenantID,
		arg.ProjectID,
		arg.Status,
		arg.ApplicantUserID,
	)
	var count int64
	err := row.Scan(&count)
	return count, err
}
